Albero: ...Wolf 1 to all units. Report your status.
Hugo: Wolf 8 here. Descent complete. No problems with my machine.
Foglia: Wolf 9. All clear here too.
Albero: Then Black Wolf will stand guard over the top of the Cradle.
Hugo: Wolf 8, roger.
Hugo: ...What is it, Foglia?
Foglia: Look, Hugo. It's always a wreck after those guys come through, but this time is especially bad.
Hugo: Yeah...
Foglia: What kind of firefight did they kick off inside the Cradle?
Hugo: Judging by the state of the surface, it must have been one fierce battle.
Foglia: Must be nice to cut loose like that. Units with <Super Robots> and new models have it made.
Hugo: And they take bigger risks for it.
Foglia: Sure, but think of the glory! Look at the ATX Team and the SRX Team. They're living the dream.
Hugo: Our job isn't to win glory. It's to carry out our orders without fail, and...
Foglia: ...come back alive, right? You're starting to sound just like my old man.
Hugo: Keep talking like that and the Captain will chew you out again.
Foglia: We're on P-mode. He can't hear us.
Albero: ...Cut the chatter, Wolf 8, Wolf 9.
Foglia: (Ugh... Don't tell me he heard that...)
Albero: Hm?
Mitar: Can you hear me, Major? We're picking up multiple EMP signatures.
Albero: What? Then...
Mitar: Yes. Fortunately, it seems some of them survived.
Albero: ...
Mitar: That raises the odds that the "Head" is here.
Mitar: The rest goes as planned, Major Albero Est.
Albero: ...Understood.
Hugo: Captain! Heat sources and moving objects ahead! Count six!
Albero: ...Here they come.
Hugo: The Einst...! There are still some left?!
Foglia: Jeez. Looks like we're cleaning up after those guys again this time.
Albero: Wolf 8, Wolf 9. I'll take down the "Armor" and the "Grass." I'm leaving the "Bone" to you.
Hugo: Wolf 8, roger.
Foglia: Wolf 9, roger.
Albero: Those may not be the only Einst out there. Expect another round.
Hugo: Roger. Foglia, I'll take forward as usual...
Hugo: Hey!
Foglia: Hugo, leave this one to me.
Hugo: Wait, the positions are...
Foglia: Just let me do it. I don't want people saying I got here through connections or favoritism.
Hugo: Who's saying that?
Foglia: You just don't hear it. ...Please, partner.
Hugo: ...All right.
1. Destroy all enemies.

Hugo: (These things... they're damaged. But for having fought those guys...)
Albero: (Are these Einst... just small fry? Or are they just as Mitar predicted...)
Foglia: I've got Dad and everyone else watching. I can't afford to screw this up!

Foglia: ...That was less of a fight than I expected.
Hugo: Yeah. Looks like the damage from their last battle hadn't fully repaired.
Foglia: So the drill wasn't just for show, huh? At this rate, Blue and Brown will have it easy too.
Hugo: I hope so.
Foglia: Wish five or six more would show up. Bag those and I'd top Kalim's kill count...
Albero: ...Warrant Officer Foglia Est.
Foglia: Wh-What is it, sir?
Albero: The Cry Wolves have no need for those obsessed with personal glory.
Foglia: ...!
Albero: I took you on because, like Hugo, you had exceptional aptitude. Not out of favoritism or bias.
Foglia: But the others...
Albero: If you rush after your own glory and disrupt the team's coordination, you're out.
Foglia: Ugh...
Foglia: !

Hugo: The one that showed up at Izu Base...!
Albero: That's right. The "Head."
Foglia: Wh-What's it doing here...?
Hugo: Is it the same one that tried to absorb the SRX?
Foglia: Maybe it's chasing Goggles?
Hugo: The Kurogane went up to Space.
Albero: ...
Foglia: Either way, this cleanup's gonna cost plenty. I'll send the Kurogane the bill.
Hugo: Don't bother. They don't even know we're operating. They'd just send it right back.
Foglia: ...Don't take a joke so seriously.
Albero: Enough chatter. Formation D, I'm on point. Cover me, Wolf 8, Wolf 9.
Hugo: Roger. ...Don't jump the gun this time, Foglia.
Foglia: ...I know.
Albero: (Just as Zapato predicted, the "Head" has appeared. Then...)

Albero: (Mitar... does he seriously intend to use something like this...!?)
Foglia: (If I had a Grungust-class Super Robot, I could take this thing alone...!)
Foglia: Tch, this bastard won't go down!
Hugo: Blue Wolf and Brown Wolf should be here soon. Until then, we just have to hold...
Albero: No. I'll use the special round.

Hugo: What's that!?
Albero: An HCC round developed by Dr. Zapato.
Hugo: Can that take it down!?
Albero: ...

Hugo: Then this operation wasn't just the Earth Cradle cleanup... it was also to capture the "Head"?
Albero: ...
Mitar: Good work, Major. Thanks to you, we've obtained an extremely valuable sample.
Mitar: Bringing you into my project was the right call.
Albero: I don't recall being placed under your direct command, Doctor.
Mitar: The result is the same. ...In any case, I'll say this: you live up to the Cry Wolves name.
Albero: ...
Mitar: I'll contact the Cradle's current director, Dr. Nate. Resupply, then keep watch over the area.
Albero: Understood.
Foglia: ...So Mitar Zapato's the one who ordered the "Head" captured.
Hugo: Yeah.
Foglia: What the hell does that guy want with a monster like that?
Hugo: ...
Earth Cradle
Earth Cradle - Interior
Mitar: This is our first meeting, Dr. Sophia Nate. I'm Mitar... Mitar Zapato.
Sophia: Zapato? You mean, of Lazmanium...?
Mitar: Yes. Egret Fehu, who was here at the Earth Cradle with you...
Mitar: We were rivals in the same field. He got two or three steps ahead of me... no, much further, it seems.
Sophia: ...
Donna: Dr. Zapato, the Tergum has been unloaded.
Mitar: Then begin the survey at once.
Donna: Judging by the internal damage, it may be better to use the Wendigo 2.
Mitar: You brought that along too?
Donna: ...Yes.
Mitar: You must want results badly... No, rather the data to help your son walk, it seems.
Donna: ...
Mitar: The Wendigo isn't built for surveys. I have no intention of damaging this Cradle any further.
Mitar: Besides, there may still be survivors in the rubble. ...Use the Tergum.
Donna: ...Understood.
Sophia: ...Who are you people? What's your affiliation?
Mitar: A special Federation research organization... That's all I'll say.
Sophia: ...
Mitar: My team is here under orders from General Staff Headquarters to handle the aftermath.
Mitar: There's a high chance enemies remain inside the Cradle or in the surrounding area...
Mitar: Patrols and enemy mop-up will be handled by Major Albero Est's Cry Wolves.
Mitar: I'll have you prepare the Earth Cradle data for us.
Mitar: The same data you submitted to the New DC, that is.
Sophia: ...Understood.
Transport - Hangar
Albero: ...Warrant Officer Foglia, what are you doing? If you're done resupplying, get out to your assigned area.
Foglia: I have a question first.
Albero: What is it?
Foglia: That order earlier... What the hell was that about?
Albero: We had orders to capture the "Head" if it appeared. That's all there is to it.
Foglia: But that thing's no POW or captured unit! It's an Einst!
Hugo: Stop it, Foglia.
Foglia: No, I'm going to say it. I can't accept the orders Mitar's been giving lately. I won't die as his dog.
Albero: Whatever the order, you carry it out without fail. That's a soldier's duty.
Foglia: But if Mitar means us harm, then fighting the "Head" will--
Albero: Then we find a way to live in the face of death.
Foglia: That's easy enough to say...!
Albero: Those who can't do it simply die, Warrant Officer Foglia Est.
Foglia: ...!
Albero: Even if they set a trap, we break through it. I've chosen subordinates who can do just that.
Foglia: Tch, the old man... He's always like that.
Hugo: ...Even the captain can't be satisfied with Mitar's orders deep down. That's what I think.
Foglia: Who knows? You give him way too much credit.
Hugo: If I can't trust the captain, what can I trust?
Foglia: Must be nice being so simple.
Hugo: ...Then why did you volunteer for the Cry Wolves?
Foglia: That's because... that man is a wall I have to get over.

Mitar: Brown Wolf will continue guarding the Earth Cradle.
Albero: (Barking orders over my head... Playing Commander, is he?)
Mitar: And you, Major, will select several pilots from Black, Blue, and Brown and lead them up into Space.
Albero: Space...?
Mitar: Yes. At Eric's request...
Mitar: You're going to the White Star.
Albero: (What...!?)
